get.summary: GET /v1/admin/ui/{page} — return RFW definition for the requested admin page.

`GET /v1/allowed-endpoints` — scope→endpoint map for this service
(helps clients pick the right token scope per endpoint; ).

post.summary:
`POST /v1/app/template-presets` — create a reusable payment-initiation
preset for a template.

`POST /v1/app/template-versions:validate` — validate a template version
payload without creating it.

get.summary:
`GET /v1/audit` — query audit events (Story ).
Returns a paginated list of audit events with filters by action,
target resource type, and date range. Requires `payments:admin` scope.

`GET /v1/cardholders` — list cardholders.
.7: holder callers see only their own cardholders
(forced here; RLS is the backstop). Staff/sys/M2M see all active
cardholders in the env.

post.summary:
`POST /v1/cardholders` — create a cardholder.
.7: `customer_id` is a Ledger customer id (by value; existence is the
caller's contract — Ledger owns customer validation via its public API;
no cross-schema FK).

get.summary:
`GET /v1/cardholders/{id}` — get a cardholder.
.7: holder callers can only fetch their own cardholders.

post.summary:
`POST /v1/cards` — create a card.
Gated by `FeatureGate::Cards`. The PAN is obfuscated with the
placeholder `CardEncryption` before being stored in `encrypted_pan`.

put.summary:
`PUT /v1/cards/3ds-records/{id}` — update 3DS authentication state
(; also fixes the list route path to /v1/cards/3ds-records).

post.summary:
`POST /v1/cards/card-order-batches` — group card orders into a
manufacturing batch.

get.summary:
`GET /v1/cards/card-orders` — list card orders (business
`card_orders:read`; `:batchGet` semantics via id list param).

post.summary:
`POST /v1/cards/card-orders` — create a card order (manufacturing /
personalisation bureau).

get.summary:
`GET /v1/cards/card-tokens/{id}` — fetch a card token's lifecycle state
(; `tokens/{token_id}` business shape).

put.summary:
`PUT /v1/cards/cardholders/{id}` — update a cardholder. **CLOSED status
cascades: all the cardholder's cards transition to DISABLED** (business
rule; done in the same transaction).

post.summary:
`POST /v1/cards/issuance:issue` — issue a card (delegates to the existing
card-issuing handler; the business route shape).

`POST /v1/cards/issuance/{id}:getDetails` — fetch the encrypted card
details (ECDH P-256 session; client-side decrypt only, §4.12).

`POST /v1/cards/issuance/{id}:replace` — replace a card (delegates to the
existing replace handler; business route shape).

`POST /v1/cards/issuance/{id}:resetLVT` — reset the Limited Value Tracker
(contactless accumulator; ).

`POST /v1/cards/issuance/{id}:updatePIN` — update the card PIN (hashes the
new PIN server-side; never stored in clear, §4.12).

get.summary:
`GET /v1/cards/products/{id}` — card product with issuing/expiry plan and
card profile.

put.summary:
`PUT /v1/cards/products/{id}` — update issuing/expiry plan on a card
product.

get.summary:
`GET /v1/cards/products/{id}/account-ranges` — list BIN account ranges
attached to a card product.

post.summary:
`POST /v1/cards/products/{id}:addAccountRanges` — attach BIN account
ranges to a card product.

`POST /v1/cards/sessions:initiate` — initiate an encrypted card session
(client key exchange; delegates to the existing session handler).

patch.summary:
`PATCH /v1/cards/{id}` — update a card (status / expiry).
When `status` is provided it is validated against the card state machine
(`cards::validate_card_transition`) before being applied.

post.summary:
Create a new encrypted card session.
Inserts a row in `card_sessions` (defined by migration
`14-payments.sql`) with `status = 'active'` and returns
the session id together with a short-lived session token (a UUID) and
the placeholder public key the client should use to encrypt the
sensitive payload. The session expires after 5 minutes by default.

Change a card PIN.
Verifies `old_pin_hash` against the stored `pin_hash`; on success the
stored hash is replaced with `new_pin_hash` and `pin_attempts` is
reset. On failure `pin_attempts` is incremented (same policy as
`verify_pin`).

Verify a card PIN.
`pin_hash` is the (already hashed) PIN the client sent, encrypted with
the session public key. Payments never stores or sees the clear PIN. The
stored `pin_hash` column on `cards` is compared against the
provided value; on mismatch `pin_attempts` is incremented and the
card is suspended when it reaches 3.

put.summary:
`PUT /v1/cards/{id}/profile` — set the Card Profile (chip behaviour /
scheme approval: Mastercard CPV/CNS, Visa DPS; ).

post.summary: `POST /v1/cards/{id}/replace` — create a replacement card, disable the old.

get.summary:
`GET /v1/config-packs` — list installed payment config packs (; the
pack contents are versioned resources: rules/rule-sets/parameter-values).

put.summary:
`PUT /v1/cores/{id}/balance-endpoint` — switch the CBS balance endpoint
between online (live query) and offline (cached) modes.

post.summary:
`POST /v1/files/{id}/submit` — submit an uploaded file for debatch +
processing (inbound flow).

`POST /v1/instruction-file-specification-versions` — create a spec
version (non-v1beta alias route).

`POST /v1beta/instruction-file-specification-versions:validate` — validate
a specification version payload without creating it (active-version
semantics; the design's `:validate` convention).

`POST /v1/instructions` — create and initiate an instruction.
Delegates workflow execution to Flow.

`POST /v1/instructions:bulkRetry` — bulk retry errored instructions
(Sentin8 Jobs pattern).

put.summary:
`PUT /v1/instructions/{id}` — update an instruction (status updates
including cancel — the business convention; no `/cancel` subpath).

post.summary:
`POST /v1/instructions/{id}:process` — process the instruction now
(business route shape; wraps the state-machine step).

`POST /v1/instructions:process` — process an instruction against its
logic (moves it to processing; the worker continues the workflow).

`POST /v1/instructions/{id}/repair` — rewind the instruction to a step and
re-process via Flow (Story ).

`POST /v1/integration-versions/{id}:retry` — retry a failed integration
version (business convention; ).

`POST /v1/integrations:callback/{token}` — the HTTPAsyncStep contract
(§4.4): an integration calls back with the response payload after an
arbitrary delay; the waiting instruction resumes its workflow.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Callback token from the initial HTTPAsyncStep call

post.summary:
`POST /v1/internal/authorisations/expire` — Sentin8:Cron proxy-back for
the daily Authorisation Expiry run . Scans authorisation
instructions past their scheme expiry TTL (7d default / 30d pre-auth /
14d mass-transit / 1h AFD, measured from `transmission_date_time`),
emits the caad.008 AdministrativeInitiation with
`ALTERNATE_MESSAGE_REASON_AUTOMATED_AUTHORISATION_EXPIRY` (party `VP`),
records the Release posting to Bank8:Ledger, and moves the payment to
`PAYMENT_STATUS_EXPIRED`.

Execute the `debatch_file` step: split the file's records into chunked
instruction batches (design §10). The step is idempotent on
`file_id:chunk_index` — a workflow retry re-enters here and the
terminal-file guard makes completed work a no-op.
post.description:
The chunk count derives from the file's `size_bytes` (the
`CHUNK_RECORDS`-record batch shell per chunk); record parsing rides the
instruction-file-spec version registered for the file's class.

post.summary: `POST /v1/internal/steps/execute` — Flow proxy-back for Payments domain steps.

`POST /v1/logics/{id}/migrate-wasm` — migrate an instruction logic's inline
hooks to Func WASM modules (Story ).
Loads the logic, walks its steps, and for every `BasicStep` whose
`config.hook` is set and `config.wasmModuleId` is absent, creates a
Func module from the step's config and uploads it via `func_client`.
Returns the list of created module ids (and any per-step errors).

`POST /v1/manual-decisions/{id}/submit` — submit a manual decision.
Records the submitter, the decision payload, and marks the decision as
`submitting`. The downstream task system picks up the row from there.

`POST /v1/membership-directory-records:search` — registry-validated
membership directory search (BIC reachability, account resolution).

get.summary:
`GET /v1/metrics` — Prometheus/OpenMetrics text format (Story ).
Exports instruction counts, payment counts, and processing latency.
Requires `bank8:payments:metrics:read` scope.

`GET /v1/on-us/routing` — B8 On-Us routing table: routes
instructions to another B8 member bank without leaving the platform.

`GET /v1/openmetrics/metrics` — OpenMetrics-format metrics (;
delegates to the shared Prometheus handler).

put.summary:
`PUT /v1/parameter-values/{id}` — update (or unset via empty body) a
parameter value.

delete.summary:
`DELETE /v1/parameters/{id}` — soft delete a parameter.
Sets `status = 'deleted'` so the row is retained for audit but excluded
from `resolve_parameter` and `list_parameters`.

get.summary:
`GET /v1/payment-statuses` — the full processing-status model exposed to
clients (; the per-type amount context keys are returned with each).

post.summary:
`POST /v1/records/search` — generic membership-directory record search
(registry-validated; delegates to the directory search).

get.summary:
`GET /v1/roles` — read view of the roles configured for this environment
(roles live in Sentin8:Auth; this is a projection for admin UIs).

post.summary:
`POST /v1/rule-set-versions/{id}/retry` — retry a failed rule set
version publish.

`POST /v1/rule-versions/{id}/retry` — retry a failed rule version
publish (; delegates to the shared retry_version helper).

`POST /v1/rules:attachToInstrument` — attach a decision rule to a payment
instrument (; the rule still applies per-instruction at runtime).
`POST /v1/rules:detachFromInstrument` — detach a rule from an instrument

`POST /v1/sandbox/instructions/{id}:resume` — fast-forward a stuck
instruction through its state machine.

`POST /v1/sandbox/scheduled-payments/{id}:fastForward` — execute the next
scheduled occurrence immediately (+ ).

`POST /v1/templates/{id}/publish` — publish the latest draft version of
a template. Marks the latest draft version as `published` and sets it as
the template's `active_version_id`.

get.summary:
`GET /v1/users` — list users visible to this environment (read view;
identities stay in Sentin8:Auth — this is a projection).

post.summary:
`POST /v1beta/scheduled-payments/{id}:fastForward` — execute the next
occurrence immediately (; non-sandbox).

instrument_id.description: payment_instrument resource this rule applies to (card or account id).

batch_size.description: Max instructions to expire in one run.

instruction_ids.description: Empty = retry all errored instructions in the env.

CoreVersionResponse.description: API response for a core version.

pan.description:
Full PAN. Only the last 4 digits are stored in `pan_last_digits`; the
full PAN is obfuscated via `cards::CardEncryption` and stored in the
`encrypted_pan` column.

customer_id.description: Ledger customer id (by value — Ledger's public API validated it).

recurrence_rule.description: RFC 5545 RRULE (e.g. FREQ=MONTHLY) — Sentin8:Cron is UTC-only.

schema.description: The specification payload (validated against the schema before creation).

oneOf.description: New value; pass `null` to **unset** the value.

input.description: Optional updated input for the instruction.

rewind_to.description: Step index to rewind to (0 = restart from beginning).

SandboxSimulationResponse.description:
Sandbox simulation state is request-scoped: the handler synthesises a
plausible result and records it in sandbox_simulations for
debugging. No real scheme/issuer side effects occur.

profile_id.description: Card Profile id (chip behaviour / scheme approval).

authentication_status.description: pending | frictionless | challenged | authenticated | failed | declined

oneOf.description: Expiry plan: expiry_months, expiry_policy, auto_renewal, etc.
Issuing plan: card_profile_id, bin_prefix, default_expiry_months, etc.

status.description: INACTIVE | ACTIVE | SUSPENDED | CLOSED (CLOSED cascades to cards).

postings_url.description: Optional new postings URL (CBS reconciliation target).

new_pin_hash.description: Pre-hashed PIN block from the encrypted session (server never sees the clear PIN).
